notes.title: Update 0.86: Goblin Arena & Gladiator, Polearm Rework, Ko-Fi Skins, Stat Pinning
notes.content: [h3][b]Uploaded build 0.86 to default branch[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Discord:[/b][/h2][p]To stay up to date on what we're actively working on, feel free to join our Discord, where we post regular development updates in our #development-updates channel, and often we pop in chat to chat with players or answer questions! [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/bUPT3bT7hk"]https://discord.gg/bUPT3bT7hk[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]Summarized Notes:[/u][/b][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Goblin Arena Event Room[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/db429728bfa6a7c263d210ef058eb5f9d36f34ff.png"][/img][/p][p]Added a new Crystal Caverns exclusive event room, The Goblin Arena.[/p][p]This new event room can only be found deep within the Crystal Caverns.[/p][p]Entering the Arena will trap any players within it, so be mindful to gather your group outside the gate before entering.[/p][p]The arena sends several waves of Goblins and Scorpions, with the final wave including a new miniboss; [b]The Goblin Gladiator.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/ac47a750932f695a48dcb2cfc88f5857058ff4e5.png"][/img][/p][p]The Goblin Gladiator is a new miniboss that can only be found in the Goblin Arena, he is a vicious opponent with 3 different melee attacks.[/p][p][/p][p][b]• "Cleave"[/b] – The Gladiator’s primary attack: a right-handed axe swing that deals 1 damage.[/p][p][/p][p][b]• "Overhead Chop"[/b] – The Gladiator’s secondary attack, dealing 1 damage and automatically triggered while the player is prone, with occasional use otherwise.[/p][p][/p][p][b]• "Whirlwind"[/b] – The Gladiator’s final attack: a spinning strike that damages all nearby crawlers, used more frequently as the Gladiator’s health decreases.[/p][p][/p][p]The Gladiator has 4 different items he can drop on death, including a [b]legendary battleaxe[/b], which are exclusive to his loot table.[/p][p]The Goblin Gladiator's health scales with the number of players inside the arena. [/p][p]The Goblin Gladiator's dropped loot scales with the number of players (1 to 3).[/p][p]Completing the arena will reward you with 4 chests, along with the Gladiator's loot drops.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Ko-Fi[/b][/h2][p]Added an in-game supporter badge next to the player's name when they are supporters of our Ko-Fi along with changing the players name to gold.[/p][p]Added several new skins for supporting us on Ko-Fi, these skins are monthly exclusive skins. [/p][p]You can support us on Ko-Fi and gain these rewards by clicking the icon in the bottom right of the game's main menu![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/36cbfa815cb9e2a01253214eed303928f3fe37d5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Corruption Gamemode Update[/b][/h2][p]When a corrupted dwarf picks up a weapon, there's a chance that the weapon becomes corrupted, and rerolls its talent to another random item talent.[/p][p]You gain a Crippling Corruption debuff to a non-corrupted dwarf that wields a corrupted item.[/p][p]Updated all talents to have a rarity in the Corruption game mode.[/p][p]Added rarity to corruption talents. Generally, stronger talents will have a higher rarity, and therefore will be rolled less often.[/p][p]Talents that proc off another talent/spell will no longer be given as a corrupted choice if the player does not have that talent/spell learned.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/32249fd60753c990670c6414b406396c8dab8232.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Polearm Rework[/b][/h2][p]Reworked and rebalanced the Polearm expertise tree, generally focused on buffing the overall damage of the different paths.[/p][p]Detailed information on the changes can be found further down these patch notes in the Expertise Section of the notes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/9f2f8670f592e7c5dad856232a1e9065b0e58d18.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Stat Pinning[/b][/h2][p]Added the ability to pin and track your character's stats, allowing you to easily see what your stats are at any given time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/357323a0c9af8a42996f905eeb41b42fa987ca65.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Volacno Balancing[/b][/h2][p]Reduced maximum health by 20%, now increases by 35% per additional player, rather than 25%.[/p][p]Volacno's grab and throw attack will now occur more often with a higher player count, and almost 3 times less when fighting him solo.[/p][p]Adjusted positions of certain blackstone weapons in Volacno to be more accessible to players during the boss fight.[/p][p]Increased damage multiplier from Blackstone Empowerment buff during Volacno boss fight from 15% -> 30%.[/p][p]When the lava sinks after Volacno is killed, all mobs in the room are killed, and the NavMesh is regenerated.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]Detailed Notes:[/u][/b][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Achievements & Perks:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]• Achievements:[/b][/p][p]Added achievement "THIS Close" with desc: "Escape a collapsing floor with 10 seconds or less remaining."[/p][p]Added achievement "Molten Bond" with desc: "Mount a Lava Wyrm."[/p][p]Added achievement "No Coffin for Me" with desc: "Survive the Forgotten Catacombs."[/p][p]Added achievement "A Worthy Hand" with desc: "Loot a legendary item."[/p][p]Added achievement "No Sudden Movements" with desc: "Sneak through the Spider Nest and loot the treasure without awakening the spiders."[/p][p]Added achievement "Beard Crit" with desc: "Deal 300 damage or more in a single hit."[/p][p]Added achievement "Minimal Damage" with desc: "Deal 1 damage in a single hit."[/p][p]Added achievement "Pacifist" with desc: "Reach floor 9 without killing a single mob, starting from floor 1."[/p][p]Added achievement "Speedy Beard" with desc: "Defeat a boss in under 15 minutes of dwarf lifetime, starting from floor 1."[/p][p]Added achievement "Apex Predator" with desc: "Kill a Lava Wyrm while riding another one."[/p][p]Added achievement "Last One Standing" with desc: "Survive the Goblin Arena."[/p][p][/p][p][b]• Perks:[/b][/p][p]Added perk "Rush Hour" with desc: "While the caves are collapsing, you have 30% increased movement speed."[/p][p]Added perk "Second Wind" with desc: "Killing a boss restores 1 to 4 health."[/p][p]Added perk "Spoils of War" with desc: "Killed bosses will drop 1 extra item. Stacks with players."[/p][p]Deleted perk "Starter Weapon", and merged it's functionality with perk "Extra Supplies".[/p][p]Changed perk "Extra Supplies" to now grant a random basic weapon as well. Extra Supplies is now a prestige reward, replacing Starter Weapon.[/p][p]Added a text pop-up when Reuse and Recycle procs on a bandage in the world.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Misc Changes:[/b][/h3][p]Added the ability topin stats to your UI, so you can see certain stat values while the inventory is closed.[/p][p]When mounted, Lava Wyrms are now controllable, rather than returning to their flight path. Your movement keys will move and turn the Wyrm, and jump as well as prone keys can be used to move the Wyrm up and down.[/p][p]You can now refill a torch up to 50% duration at a campfire only once.[/p][p]Developers will now be marked with a yellow name and dev icon in multiplayer lobbies.[/p][p]Buffs that apply a stat can still be applied to mobs that are immune to that stat, but the stat itself won't affect them. This means buffs like the Enchanted Trident's slow **can be applied to bosses**.[/p][p]Added the ability to rotate the player in the customize screen, along with a small info question mark.[/p][p]Added the skin's icon right next to it's name in the customize screen.[/p][p]Added a campfire icon and hover text to players while in a room. Hovered campfire icons display the character's saved seed. Changed the error pop-up to display seeds and be more clear if you're joining a game with a different seed then yours.[/p][p]Added an icon representing each skin's reward origin in the customize screen: the Expedition Pass, Steam, Tasks, or from supporting us on Ko-fi.[/p][p]Clicking on a locked skin from a battle pass will open the battle pass screen, from Ko-fi will open Ko-fi, and from Steam will open the Steam item store.[/p][p]Added an in-game supporter badge next to the player's name when they are supporters of our Ko-Fi along with changing the players name to gold.[/p][p]If the timer reaches 0 while you are taking an exit (such as riding a minecart) during Cave Collapse, you will not be killed.[/p][p]Updated Missing Mineshaft task icon.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Environment:[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/ac9a7f3743870a0d1d36b4472590b5b4a74c7870.png"][/img][/p][p]Added new Dwarven Caves Room Small Spikes 3 Doors.[/p][p]Added a new bridge in Lava 3 Doors room.[/p][p]Minor change the dwarven standard room 3 to improve mob navigation.[/p][p]Brazier coals no longer have colliders.[/p][p]All candles in any room are now lightable.[/p][p][/p][p][b]• Forgotten Catacombs:[/b][/p][p]Added a new hallway room to the Forgotten Catacombs.[/p][p]Updated visuals of Forgotten Catacombs Exit room.[/p][p]Reduced the overall length from the start to end.[/p][p]Increased the number and length of branching paths, allowing for more maze-like structure.[/p][p]Slightly improved performance in a bunch of minor ways.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Items:[/b][/h3][p]Added Shoulders item type.[/p][p][/p][p][b]• New Items:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/2a13a0f203ae8275fd31bb3b90ccc524a233b6ea.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Added new legendary axe Gladiator's Battleaxe, which is dropped off the Goblin Gladiator.[/p][p]Added new epic shoulders Gladiator's Pauldrons, which is dropped off the Goblin Gladiator.[/p][p]Added new rare ring Bloody Band, which is dropped off the Goblin Gladiator.[/p][p]Added new rare trinket Barbed Chain, which is dropped off the Goblin Gladiator.[/p][p]Added new rare ring Lucky Band, which can be found within the Molten Collapse.[/p][p]Added new common cloak Fur-Lined Cloak, which can be notes.title: Hotfix 0.817: Loot Balancing and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h2][b]Uploaded build 0.817 to default branch[/b][/h2]


[h3][b]Balancing:[/b][/h3]
Reworked Sharpening Stone effect to "Increase damage with bladed weapons by +1." 
Reworked Crystal Sharpening Stone effect to "Increase damage with bladed weapons by +1, additionally increase critical strike damage by 25%." 
Reworked Molten Sharpening Stone effect to "Increase damage with bladed weapons by +1, additionally increase critical strike chance by 3%." 
Increased Gold Ring critical strike chance per proc from 1%->2%.
Changed Linen Pouch to no longer spawn within the Crystal Caverns loot pool.
Updated Bloody Combo to now work with swords.
Moved Bloody Combo dagger spell to be connected to Defensive Reflexes instead of Rip.
Removed connection between Keeping Distance and Quick Reflexes.
Removed spelling error in Parrying Slashes.
Lowered Tarnished Hero's Helmet item proc duration from 20 -> 10 seconds. 
Reduced the spawn chance of lootable skeletons.
Updated loot pool of item stuck in beam of Crystal Abandoned Minecart event room.


[h3][b]Misc Changes:[/b][/h3]
Added a tutorial pop-up for spectating.
Joining a friend through Steam before the game is open will join their game as soon as the game opens.
Going down now closes all open panels.
Reduced the delay in between spectating fire pops.


[h3][b]Fixes:[/b][/h3]
Fixed various helmets hovering over or sitting too low on lootable skeletons head.
Fixed Large Chests rolling the same item twice.
Fixed Sharpening Stone trinket effect not having correct buff icon.
Fixed perks appearing slotted after prestiging and coming back from a run.
Fixed Obsidian Pommel granting infinitely decreased attack speed.
Fixed Mithril Glaive's move speed increase not having a duration.
Fixed interactable swapping with an armor item not working.
Fixed one of the torch's fire effect being enabled when extinguished.
Fixed players health being set to max when spawning with zero health.
Fixed the health bar heart shaking infinitely when the game is paused.
Fixed the proc from Mithril Glaive being infinite.
Fixed Ancient Shrines sometimes not granting the player corrupt rerolls.
Fixed the new Molten Collapse music track playing at the start of every floor.
Fixed many broken tasks that required the player to interact or extract with an item or interactable.
Fixed Goblin Shaman getting stuck, and not casting any ability for some time.
Fixed Fiery Cyclone walking towards the player when it has no attack.
Fixed the Target Dummy not being in the Crystal Caverns and Molten Collapse.
Fixed the Target Dummy being stunnable.
Fixed sleeping players granting XP on deletion.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.811: Ko-fi, Legendary Balancing, Campfire Change & Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h2][b]Uploaded build 0.811 to default branch[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Misc Changes:[/b][/h3]
Added a Ko-fi button on the main menu, and in the settings menu.
Changed "Nelizyeck's Tribute" desc to: "Hitting a mob spawns a tentacle from the void to fight other nearby mobs."
The void tentacle from "Nelizyeck's Tribute" now has a cooldown.
Void tentacle's now deal 25% weapon damage every second.
Campfires no longer blow out when an item is looted or a mob is killed. 
You gain a "Restful" buff at the start of every floor, which allows you to sleep at a campfire. 
Looting an item or killing a mob removes your "Restful" buff, and only yours.


[h3][b]Fixes:[/b][/h3]

• Refill Torch, which refills your currently held torch duration up to 50%.
• Sleep, which saves and exits your character from a run. This is NOT the same as extracting, as you are unable to take that character into another, different run. notes.title: SNEAK PEEK into 0.81: Campfires, Save Game, Gear Rework, Legendary Sword & More!
notes.content:
[h1][b]CAVE CRAWLERS![/b][/h1]

Greetings Crawlers! We have been slowly but surely working on our next content update for cave crawlers, update 0.81. We are very excited to showcase just SOME of what we have been working on over the past two months. 


[h2][b]Discord:[/b][/h2]
To stay up to date on what we're actively working on, feel free to join our Discord, where we post regular development updates in our #development-updates channel, and often we pop in chat to chat with players or answer questions!
https://discord.gg/bUPT3bT7hk


[h2][b]Campfires/Save Game System:[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/445e020eddeed43e780baf9d617d8dec4c5aa0ae.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/3f1d26111210d6d94c0e59e659dd2ce7dbb56942.png[/img]
A major new addition coming in 0.81 is campfires. You can find a campfire at the start of every floor. Campfires serve as a rest spot before you begin a floor. When you first sit down at a campfire, you will have various actions you can choose to do at the campfire. Currently, there are two possible actions a player can take, but in the future, we may add more! You can only take one action at each campfire. The two actions currently are:

• Heal, which can heal up to 2 missing HP, depending on how much missing HP you have in total.

• Sleep, which saves and exits your character from a run. This is NOT the same as extracting, as you are unable to take that character into another, different run. If you would like to use that character, you must continue that specific run you exited from. You are unable to bring NEW players into a saved run, but if multiple people decide to sleep at the same campfire, you will all be able to continue that run together so long as you all saved and exited on the same floor.


[h2][b]Gear and Equipment Rework:[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/faa251b7357fa89c7588c23f9a64d2d53f2acc68.png[/img]

Armor is getting a major change in 0.81! We are removing your character's helmet, boots, backpack, and trinket slots to replace them with Equipment slots. Equipment slots allow you to equip [b]ANY[/b] piece of gear previously equipable to those specific helmet, boots, etc slots. In addition to this, we are adding a restriction on how many of a specific item type you can equip. For example, items such as boots and helmets will have a restriction of one equipped at a time, but items such as rings or trinkets will have NO restriction on the number you can have equipped at once. 

This change will allow players to diversify what equipment they would like to use, being able to use 5 rings or 3 trinkets and a helmet + backpack if they would like! There will also be multiple new item types added, such as back, belts, and bracers. 

Finally, nearly every piece of gear has been significantly changed. Most items have had their stats and procs adjusted or completely changed. To supplement this change, we have removed proc restrictions from gear. If you have two Gold Rings equipped that both have a 35% chance on hit to proc a 1% crit buff, each hit on a mob will now proc BOTH equipped rings, instead of previously rolling just once, giving you two separate 35% rolls to gain 1% crit. 


[h2][b]New Legendary Weapons:[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/008cfa9f00009fe837fffe2758952ac8a55637d7.png[/img]

As requested by the community, multiple new legendary weapons are in development! One legendary coming in 0.81 is "Nezyeck’s Tribute", a legendary broadsword with the ability to spawn horrifying tentacles and portals from the void.


[h2][b]Torch Update:[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/067aca7d0d5037795aa2d819cdcdb8fc4986c910.gif[/img]

As you may have noticed in one of the previous pictures, torches are getting a visual update! Most torches will have this new animated fire effect to them that will shrink and get dimmer as the torch runs out of torch duration.


[h2][b]Large Chests:[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/9da57c5f1b80693952ed028e820190f3cc71405a.png[/img]

Large Chests are a new type of chest that will rarely spawn instead of a regular chest. These large chests, when opened, reveal TWO different items, but only ONE can be taken from the chest.


[h2][b]New Music:[/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=mmLIOGC5XFM;full][/previewyoutube]
Two new tracks are currently WIP and are likely coming in 0.81! Above is a demo of "Into the Embers", a new track for the Molten Collapse.


[h2][b]Sneak Peek:[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/5cb576dc89c78cdc798b398dea34a4ed46c378ac.png[/img]

A mysterious new goblin roams the caves...


[h2][b]Final Thoughts:[/b][/h2]
0.81 is a sizable content update primarily focused on adding highly requested additions the community has been asking for, as well as new content introducing more player decisions to make within a run. There are many other additions we didn't discuss: new prestige rewards, new rooms, many new items, and much more! We are very excited to see what you think of the Sneak Peek, so please discuss your thoughts in the comments below as well as in our official Discord.

notes.title: SNEAK PEEK Into 0.8: New Biome Reveal, Lobby Matchmaking, and More!
notes.content:
[h1][b]CAAAAAAAVE CRAWLERS![/b][/h1]

Hello Crawlers! Two months have gone by without a new update, our longest gap since releasing onto early access. We've been hard at work on our biggest update yet: 0.8! In 0.8, we are going to release the 3rd biome spanning from floors 21-30, along with some of the other additions we'll be showcasing below!


[h2][b]Discord:[/b][/h2]
To stay up to date on what we're actively working on, feel free to join our discord where we post regular development updates in our #development-updates channel, and often we pop in chat to chat with players or answer questions!
https://discord.gg/bUPT3bT7hk


[h2][b]New Biome Reveal: The Molten Collapse![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/e9bd561042ee9a25d6590fc33d28391e848ca676.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/42304ccd11bfad29f313478143bc63c745eb11df.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/cf17cd1b780587021e1df6256998c1091b9cf018.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/9171c9b4fe773bbc2d431463182c2be0e818f65f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/f7be3887a1788e2f47cf421e1e800c2cbd0d1bdd.png[/img]

The Molten Collapse is the 3rd and most challenging biome coming to Cave Crawlers! Prepare your dwarves for a true test of skill, as this treacherous layer introduces some of the toughest and most complex enemies we have ever created, found only within these fiery depths. 

The cavern's walls are rugged and brown, scorched by the intense heat emanating from nearby pools of molten lava that bubble and crackle ominously. The ceiling and walls are often a chaotic maze of stalactites, hiding the dangerous new enemies lurking around every corner. Within the Molten Collapse, the very air shimmers from the heat found this deep below the surface. Venturing into the Molten Collapse isn't just about braving its deadly inhabitants; the environment itself is a constant threat. Are you daring enough to delve into this inferno and conquer the dangers that lie within?

[u][i]Graphics and lighting shown are WIP and subject to change.[/i][/u]

[h2][b]New Mob: The Stonelings[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/23f4c445d5c9830117a526105bec4ffd4a2921e3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/258e4ff525ef90f4ae04163373c549751f344d46.png[/img]

The Stonelings are said to be the remnants of ancient dwarves who once inhabited the molten collapse, a treacherous cave biome filled with lava. Long ago, these dwarves mined deep into the earth, seeking precious minerals and forging mighty weapons. However, a catastrophic eruption trapped them within the fiery depths. Over time, their souls fused with the surrounding rock and magma, transforming them into the stone-skinned Stonelings. Now, these vengeful spirits guard the molten collapse, eternally bound to the place of their demise, attacking any who dare to intrude on their final resting place.

These are one of the most basic mobs which can be found residing within the Molten Collapse. Stonelings can often be found in small groups, and will stumble their way towards any threat, swinging wildly in an attempt to strike them with their rocky fists. If a threat is too far away, or unreachable to the Stonelings, they will pull boulders out of the earth below them to throw at their target.

[h2][b]New Loot Source: Pots[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/f241fb52c63a0b4f18660741d6f44841d140ab82.png[/img]

Seeing as wooden crates aren't exactly flame-proof, crates within the Molten Collapse have been replaced by clay pots containing similar loot. They're quite satisfying to smash!

[h2][b]More To Discover![/b][/h2]
This is only a small peek into the Molten Collapse. A whole new set of enemies to fight, new loot to acquire, and of course a final boss on floor 30 are all to be discovered in 0.8!


[h2][b]Public Lobby Matchmaking:[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/6a5ebba82939282542348acedfe6f9b9d1bb2850.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/600d6bf80a858f3f33586f33e8adfa67d40d7564.png[/img]

A new system to allow you to find other players and begin new runs together is coming with 0.8! What does this mean for the existing lobby system and how is this different?

The public lobby system will allow you to set multiplayer lobby from private to public, below are the differences:
• Private lobbies can only be joined if you have the room's code, or have been sent an invite to the lobby through Steam.
• Public lobbies can be joined using the new lobby search system, which will be the first screen you see when you click "Together" on the main menu. You can also join a public lobby using either of the private lobby methods.

You may only start or join public lobbies with characters who are set to begin their adventure on floor 1, in most cases being a fresh character. Characters saved to floor 5 or higher will have to host or join a private lobby. Along with the new lobby system, we also added a text chat to use while in a lobby.


[h2][b]New System: Slayer Score[/b][/h2]
Slayer Score is a new way to earn expertise points in 0.8. Instead of gaining expertise based on how many mobs you've killed, you will now earn expertise by gaining "Slayer Score" from mobs you defeat. The amount of score you gain is dependent on how tough an enemy was to defeat.

For example: the easy-to-kill Slime grants 1 Slayer Score, where as the hard-to-kill Crystal Scorpion grants 5 Slayer Score. These numbers are subject to change!


[h2][b]Expertise Expansion[/b][/h2]
Every weapon's expertise tree is being expanded with 0.8. This expansion is still work in progress, but below are some examples of talents that we have already added and begun testing with internally!

• New Hammer talent, Sacred Seal: "After casting the spell "Holy Strike", grant a random nearby player additional attack damage for a short duration." 
• New Hammer talent, Fortified: "Blocking an attack or taking damage has a high chance to give you and a nearby player increased attack speed." 
• New Axe talent, Swift Cleave: "Chance on hit to reduce the cooldown of "Cleave" by 1 second." 
• New Axe talent, Critical Cleave: "Dealing a critical strike reduces the cooldown of "Cleave"." 
• New Dagger talent, Improved Dazing Strike: "Appling "Dazing Strike" additionally has a 50% chance to stun the affected mob for 1 second." 
• New Sword talent, Intimidating Aura: "After casting any spell, all nearby mobs take 10% increased damage from all sources for a short duration."
• New Polearm talent, Expose Weakness: "Stunning a mob increases its damage taken for 4 seconds." 
• New Armor talent, Blowback: "Blocking an attack has a chance to stun up to 3 nearby mobs for 3 seconds." 
• New Ranged talent, Mobile Maniac: "Casting either "Dash" or "Evasion" while holding a ranged weapon increases your movement speed by 3% per stack until you stand still."


[h2][b]New Crawlers Pass:[/b][/h2]
With the release of 0.8, we plan to release a new purchasable crawlers pass. This new pass will have 31 tiers consisting of 29 fresh new cosmetic skins to customize your dwarves with, and 2 additional character slots earnable within the pass. Similar to the current pass, there will be various free cosmetic rewards to earn for those who choose not to purchase the pass!

This will [b]NOT[/b] replace the current crawlers pass, the "Expedition Pass", nor will it prevent you from purchasing or progressing that pass after its release. If you own both passes, you will simply choose which pass you would like to earn experience towards.


[h2][b]Final Thoughts:[/b][/h2]
0.8 is the largest and most challenging update to Cave Crawlers yet. There are many other  additions we didn't discuss: new perks, tasks, items, and much more! We are very excited to see what you think of the Sneak Peek, so please discuss your thoughts in the comments below as well as in our official discord. Finally, when should you expect 0.8 to release?

[b]We expect update 0.8 to be ready sometime in September.[/b] We have a lot more to share, with a new trailer and an announcement of the exact release date coming once we get closer to release!

notes.title: SNEAK PEEK into 0.7: Hammers, Prestige Rewards, New Content, and More!
notes.content:
[h1][b]CAAAAAAVE CRAWLERS![/b][/h1]

We've been working hard over the past month trying to get update 0.7 out to you as quickly as possible. Internally, the scope of the update has grown considerably. We believe the update is taking longer than what might be expected, so we wanted to give everyone a little sneak peek into just SOME of what we're working on! 

[h2][b]New Weapon Type, Hammers:[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/78b40c99dbe24842ad727c7cb2c192f3bd7d7f71.png[/img]

Hammers, a whole new weapon type is being added to the game! Hammers are a slow-swinging, hard-hitting melee weapon with high knockback. With the addition of hammers, we will finally be filling that section on the top left of the expertise tree with the hammer expertise. Hammers will be a multi-role weapon being able to build into a support/tank build or a pure damage build. We also have a few awesome new spells in the works for hammers that should give it a distinct feel from the other weapons!


[h2][b]Prestige Rewards:[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/9d4c1549631c9d7b7b00a947740e5f6c8b026f8b.png[/img]

A highly requested and long-awaited addition has been more rewards past your first prestige! Along with prestige rewards, we are revamping the UI for the main menu talent tree to support the addition of more prestige rewards, and in the future, the perk system. We have a multitude of new rewards you'll be able to choose from whenever you prestige. An infinitely repeating reward is also planned but will more than likely not make it into this update. 

[b]If your prestige level is CURRENTLY greater than one, after logging into the new update you'll be able to choose whatever prestige rewards your level has earned you. You will NOT miss any prestige rewards by prestiging BEFORE the update's release.[/b]

[h2][b]Sneak Peek:[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/6598558e91de72ce68bf75d5240ab7b13523e4cd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/a68ef92e58cee45686c5a40f1e7c81b3676f2538.png[/img]

Some secrets within the Crystal Caverns are best left undiscovered...


[h2][b]Dagger Expertise Tree Rework:[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/6d206c61f3501b647dfdab354a78fec96c129e45.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/ed670f986cedd87ad491c42eeca2e5a2e5cabee9.png[/img]

Daggers after the .66 combat rework have felt a lot tougher to use than other weapons, especially against large groups of enemies. While our design with daggers is to be a high-risk high single target damage weapon, it is currently not as powerful as we feel it should be and doesn't have the survivability it needs to compete against the other weapon types outside of boss fights. 

To help bring daggers up to where the other weapons are, we've done a complete reorganization of the dagger tree from the ground up. We looked at every talent and made changes to roughly 30% of the talents, as well as added one new spell and 2 brand-new talents! The picture of the new tree above is an earlier in-development screenshot, the final tree will look different but it should give you a good idea of what changes are coming.

notes.content:
[b]Uploaded build 0.62 to default branch[/b]


[b]Strange Ritual Circle:[/b]
The Ritual Circle is a brand new event room we've added to the game. This event room has two primary uses, trading unwanted items for a random item of often better rarity, and more importantly [b]reviving players who have permanently died in a run![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/4986107a66dc75e996d488356ad194f4a4a47c94.png[/img]

The Ritual Circle is an altar surrounded by a ring of candles. Purple runes glow along the walls of this cave which let you know the ritual can be activated. Dropping an item onto the altar, then lighting the candles surrounding it activates the ritual, trading the item sacrificed for an item of random rarity (typically better) as well as having a chance to revive a fallen player.

The odds of getting a better quality item are based on the rarity of the item you put in, the higher the rarity of the item you're sacrificing, the higher the odds of reviving a dead player or being given a powerful item! You can even be given hard mode exclusive items as rewards from the ritual.

If you don't want to sacrifice an item, you may sacrifice your own character's health instead by interacting with the altar without holding any item in your hands, which has the highest odds of reviving a fallen player. 


[b]Environment:[/b]
Added a new way to find loot in the caves, piles of kickable rocks can now be found around corners of the caves rarely hiding consumables and trinkets underneath them.

notes.title: Update 0.61 patch notes: Goblin Village, Shaman Miniboss, Ambient Music, & more!
notes.content:
[b]Uploaded build 0.61 to default branch[/b]

[b]Goblin Village:[/b]
The Goblin Village event room was this updates community-voted addition! 

This event room can be found in the Dwarven Caves. The village is FILLED with both goblins and loot, this is the goblin's base of operations around the caves and contains our newest mob addition, the Goblin Shaman. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43088884/ee2db7baea6fd4022726e83ba4dbe83c898c806b.png[/img]

The Shaman is a new miniboss that can only be found in the Goblin Village, he does not have any melee attacks and instead has 3 different spells he can cast based on his combat situation:

[b]• "Earthen Eruption"[/b] is the Shaman's main attack, this summons an earthen spike trail leading towards its target dealing 1 damage whenever a dwarf is standing under the spikes as they arise from the ground.

[b]• "Elemental Shove"[/b] is the Shaman's secondary attack, only being cast whenever the Shaman is under attack from dwarves in melee range. The Shaman first casts a gust of wind which will push any nearby dwarves away, then he raises a circle of earthen spikes around himself which deals 1 damage to any dwarf caught in the spikes.

[b]• "Ring of Rejuvenation"[/b] This is the Shaman's final spell, only being cast whenever more than half of the mobs around him are less than 70% health, or if the Shaman's health is below 70%. After casting, the shaman will send out a ring of healing expanding from him healing any goblin which touches the ring for 30% of their total health. This spell has a 10 second cooldown.

The shaman has 4 different items he can drop on death which are exclusive to his loot table.
